description: Allowed minute-step values for TmTimeSelector / TmTimePicker: the positive divisors of 60 other than 60 itself (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 12, 15, 20, 30). Validate throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException; the parameter name defaults to MinuteStep and a caller such as a range picker can pass EndMinuteStep.
